exact_required_original_action_pullback.bulk_action_Hessian: H_coll=(D Phi_coll)^T H_original(D Phi_coll)+sum_a g_original,a D^2 Phi_coll,a.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.bulk_action_gradient: g_coll=(D Phi_coll)^T g_original in the declared realified/analytic coordinate convention.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.event_matrices: The owned decomposition of H_coll and its actual retarded complement must produce P_coll,B_coll,L_coll^R,C_coll,J_coll,d_coll, including cross-event/interbranch terms, all six sectors and boundary/source contacts.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.event_topology: If the realized solution genuinely has several geometric incoming or successor branches, its actual branch incidence and signed trace maps must be supplied by the existing branch-transfer action. The generic allowance of one or more successors is not an evaluated four-branch event.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.external_kinematics: Evaluate the Lorentz/half-density/source map from equal-energy head-on e-/e+ momenta and the energy scan into these common field traces; original raw268 q/v entries are not beam four-momenta.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.first_unavailable_in_this_numeric_matche: The value-level Phi_coll/common-domain collision incidence and its induced original-action P/B/L/C/J/d, rather than a missing general Schur solver.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.jet_requirement: Supply value/u/v/uv for those six operands from the same collision geometry/source/domain, with moving trace/coframe/source/constraint curvature contacts. Fixed-domain PR derivatives alone do not perform this pullback.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.nonstationary_contact: The g*D2Phi term is mandatory at the retained nonstationary base; no zero-gradient shortcut or duplicated worldtube source is allowed.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.object: An evaluated collision embedding/incidence Phi_coll from the prepared incoming pair and outgoing detector/projector trace data into ONE common original full-field event domain, with actual embeddings/coframes/normal orientations and common action identity.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.observable: For a collider cross section, also retain the connected four-external-leg/LSZ or equivalent admitted source-response and asymptotic normalization. A small classical KKT residual is not that amplitude.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.quantum_state_incidence: Use the existing electron/positron and muon/antimuon one-particle embeddings plus the charge-conjugate CAR/Fock two-particle construction on that common domain. Particles are excitations/occupations; particle count is not the number of classical cap snapshots.
exact_required_original_action_pullback.source_binding: The actual pair-preparation/annihilation and pair-detection source functionals must be pulled through the retained interacting gauge/fermion action and connected propagator prescription; a one-particle reset lift alone only transports a trace and cannot substitute for a connected four-leg transition.

general_AE4_and_PR468.convention: Hermitian parent jets and conjugate-transpose real-source pairing. The active muon complex-germ action uses analytic transpose; a proven realification/pairing conversion is required before reuse.
general_AE4_and_PR468.squared_unsquared: PR universal pole convention is squared; active muon unsquared boundary-pencil values are not silently identified with it.
general_AE4_and_PR468.u_v: Two independent real source parameters on one fixed common domain, not two physical particles or incoming arms.

identity_compatibility_checklist: Common action version and mathematical scalar, background/event identity, actual global domain and selected time/retarded prescription.
Same carrier/family/charge-conjugation maps and full source normalization; no square-matrix dimension identification between inequivalent spaces.
Opposite branch normals and actual signed cotangent pullback at the same event; material wall and proper-normal conversion counted once.
Actual initial transverse/environmental field functions or a complete globally retarded past source selector; outgoing-only labels do not choose them.
Declared real/complex pairing and squared/unsquared spectral conventions; no Hermitianization or dropped rows.
main_conclusion: The existing common AE4 event algebra can be reused after a same-action collider pullback is evaluated. The original226 two-arm numerical matcher and PR468 two-source labels cannot be relabeled as two incoming/two outgoing particles.

saved_birth_transport_code_review.dimensions: Old joint352=parent146+child206; child360=(x154,v154,y52), canonical308. These do not identify current368/316 or product410/358.
saved_birth_transport_code_review.product_rule_scope: T*Dhseed and forced R*DhUp are valid additive pieces only. Missing DhM/DhR, baseline Euler-force first, cut/step/frame/source/clock and endpoint/domain contacts are explicitly retained as missing.
saved_birth_transport_code_review.seed_source_ownership: Initial values are the saved action-derived child seed and parent Up. Theta is a natural/adjoint readout, not a state impulse. No conditional c0 repair or CAR/environment fallback is inserted.
saved_birth_transport_code_review.source_return: sum_i h_i J_i^T(Hpc_i eta_i+Hpp_CHILD_i J_i Up), with direct CHILD leaf, not OWN subtraction or duplicated parent bulk.
saved_birth_transport_code_review.terminology: X^T Pi is a canonical trace-cotangent pairing. It is not by itself the antisymmetric Green form X^T Pi-Pi^T X or a complete physical terminal flux/load.
saved_birth_transport_code_review.trial_first: (DhUp)^T source_return is right trial/domain motion counted once; the independent source adjoint stays fixed.
